local.note: Local only: Parakeet plus the fail-closed DeBERTa masker, measured on this device. Deliberately kept apart from the network figure below, because a slow answer caused by wifi is not caused by the privacy system.

llm.note: Stubbed transport: the request was built and parsed by the real client but answered locally, so this timing is the integration's own cost with no network in it, and the placeholder-preservation figure describes a cooperative responder rather than Groq.

end_to_end.success_definition: usable transcript, masking released, no raw private value in the outbound payload, deterministic rehydration probe restored every value, the request succeeded (stubbed transport), no corrupted placeholder in the reply, every returned placeholder resolved, and a non-empty restored answer.

privacy_round_trip.definition: Three independent checks against the bytes the LLM client handed to urllib. The first asserts that no value the masker replaced appears in the payload. The second asserts that no gold private surface from the manifest appears in it. The third asserts that the text the recognizer actually produced for each gold entity - located by the same alignment the audio benchmark uses - is absent too, which is what catches an entity the recognizer altered and the privacy model then missed. Every side is number-folded first, so a telephone number spoken as words and written as digits still matches.

placeholder_preservation.definition: Of the replies that used any bracketed token at all, how many used only tokens that were in the request. A reply containing [Name], [GIVENNAME] or an invented [TIME_1] counts as corrupted, because no local map can fill it. Meaningful only against a live model: a stubbed run scores the responder this file wrote.

tts.speaks: the locally restored answer, never the masked reply
